fields.why: The new split con cyclones (251-CY-604) have 4 blanks installed in the cluster in cyclones 2, 6, 10, 14 as noted in Citect. The process to swap into the blanked configuration now can be quite time-consuming and required multiple actions from the CRO’s. As this will typically occur during a ramp down & ramp up (when the CRO’s are the busiest), there is the opportunity to create a sequence to automate it and save the CRO some time.
fields.design:
Create a level controller LIC-4065B for HP-607 so that the pumps Pu-723/724 can run to level control when blanked and as part of the sequence. Add a selector to be able to swap between that steady state PIC-4088 or that LIC (similar to what we have in place on Pu-59 to run in level control when the bypass valve is open).

Create a Cyclone Count Target Input (initial value = 10) so that the sequence knows how many cyclones to open as part of the un-blanking process. Minimum value = 4, Maximum value = 12.

Blanking sequence:
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure all 16 valves are in auto, and ensure that SP of LIC-4065B is higher than the SP of LIC-4065 to run minimal flow
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure all 16 proxies are healthy, and that the 4 blanked cyclones are closed (XV-4073, 4077, 4081, 4085)
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure Pu-723 or Pu-724 is running
- Start of the sequence
- Switch selector from PIC-4088 to LIC-4065B for the pump to run in level control
- Open XV-4073 - once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4074 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4075 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4076 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- Open XV-4077 - once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4078 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4079 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4080 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- Open XV-4081 - once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4082 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4083 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4084 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- Open XV-4085 - once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4086 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4087 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4072 is open, close it – once close proxy is active, move to next step
- Confirm XV-4073, 4077, 4081, 4085 are open and that the cyclone count is 4
- Sequence complete

Un-blanking sequence:
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure all 16 valves are in auto, and ensure that SP of PIC-4088 is as per met target
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure all 16 proxies are healthy, and that the 4 blanked cyclones are open (XV-4073, 4077, 4081, 4085)
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure Pu-723 or Pu-724 is running
- Prior to start the sequence, ensure there are enough cyclones not OOS to reach to Cyclone Count Input target with all un-blanked cyclones
- Start of the sequence
- If XV-4074 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4074 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4075 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4075 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If cyclone count current # valves open >4 move to next step, else If XV-4076 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4076 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- Close XV-4077 - once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4078 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4078 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4079 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4079 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If cyclone count current # valves open >4 move to next step, else If XV-4080 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4080 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- Close XV-4081 - once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4082 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4082 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4083 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4083 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If cyclone count current # valves open >4 move to next step, else If XV-4084 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4084 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- Close XV-4085 - once close proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4086 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4086 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If XV-4087 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4087 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- If cyclone count current # valves open >4 move to next step, else If XV-4072 OOS, move to next step, else open XV-4072 – once open proxy is active, move to next step
- Close XV-4073 - once close proxy is active, move to next step
- Check # open (should be between 4 and 8 at that point of the sequence) vs target, if not enough open, open one of the remaining available ones that are not open (XV-4076, then XV-4080, then XV-4084, then XV-4072) and move to next step once # open = target. If too much open, close open cyclones one at a time until # open = target.
- Confirm XV-4073, 4077, 4081, 4085 are close and that the cyclone count is = target count
- Switch selector from LIC-4065B to PIC-4088 for the pump to run in pressure control
- Sequence complete
fields.impact: CROs run one sequence to blank/un-blank instead of operating 16 valves manually.
